title: PresenceMetadata
description: Metadata shape for contentType 'contributor'. Contributor presence in the content graph — the bridge between identity and stewardship standing.

presenceState.description: Presence lifecycle: unclaimed | claimed | active | dormant

establishingContentIds.description: Content IDs that established this contributor presence (first contributions)

affinityTotal.description: Accumulated affinity score from curation acts (not attention)

uniqueEngagers.description: Count of unique humans who have engaged with this contributor's content

citationCount.description: Number of times this contributor's content has been cited or referenced

recognitionScore.description: Aggregate recognition from economic events flowing to this contributor
